description:
USC’s Information Sciences Institute (ISI) , a unit of the university’s Viterbi School of Engineering, is a world leader in the research and development of advanced information processing, computing, communications and artificial intelligence technologies. ISI’s 400 faculty, professional staff and graduate students carry out extraordinary information sciences research at three distinct locations - Arlington, VA; Marina Del Rey, CA; and Waltham, MA.

 ISI’s CS&T Division has an opening in Arlington, VA for an ASIC Research Engineer – Front-end Digital Design , to perform digital design of advanced ASIC prototypes addressing problems of national importance. The Engineer will work with a cutting-edge team to design and verify register-transfer level (RTL) models of CPUs, memories, and accelerators for applications such as communications, signal processing, and security. The Engineer will have opportunities to collaborate with ISI’s MOSIS 2.0 service, integrate third-party IP cores, and gain experience working with top research sponsors such as DARPA, IARPA, and the CHIPS Act. The position provides a collaborative, flexible university setting with rich learning and growth opportunities. The Engineer will gain experience in a fast-moving research setting and work toward a better and more secure future. 

 The work will be based in ISI's Arlington, VA office. 
 

 Minimum Qualifications 

 Ability to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). Per U.S. government regulations, eligibility to handle CUI requires U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency. 
 Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
 Bachelor’s degree with >3 years of experience, or Master’s degree
 Demonstrated excellence creating digital designs with Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL RTL
 Solid understanding of computer architecture and microarchitecture
 Demonstrated skills with EDA tools, scripting, revision control
 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience using logic synthesis and timing tools
 Familiarity with digital design verification
 Familiarity with performance modeling
 Familiarity with agile hardware design methodologies
 Experience with AI-assisted workflows
 Experience using FPGAs
 Effective at verbal communication and giving clear explanations
 
 The annual base salary range for this position is $115,000 to $140,000. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

 Why work at ISI 

 Work on exciting and engaging projects that have real-life impact.
 Small project team environment allows for involvement across entire project lifecycle.
 A quality work-life balance.
 Opportunities for free, top-tier university education for you and your children.
 Great benefits - medical to matched retirement 
  
 
 
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree, combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education 
Minimum Experience: 3 years 
Preferred Education: Master's degree 
Preferred Experience: 5 years 
Required Skills: Experience with Linux. 
Preferred Skills: Proven leadership ability. Experience with artificial intelligence, very large-scale integration design, machine learning, deep learning (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, HuggingFace), and Dockerization.
